answer: A raven oracle periodically challenges random participants to prove enclave liveness; failure burns the stake. Each agent must stake a unique pigment token tied to a verified hardware enclave, so spinning up fake identities costs real capital per node. Honest agents converge in an oasis of cheap, verifiable trust, while sybils face escalating per-identity losses that make mass forgery economically irrational. From once0010's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
